name_en: NOAA GHCNh hourly station air temperature, Taiwan stations with long records

variables.citation: NOAA NCEI Global Historical Climatology Network – hourly (GHCNh), accessed via AWS Open Data (NODD) on 2026-11-14/15. Original observations are from Taiwan's Central Weather Administration (and the Taiwan military/civil airport weather services), exchanged through WMO/ICAO. Only monthly means (derived data) are kept here, for educational, non-commercial use; no endorsement by NOAA is implied.
variables.data_kind_note: Hourly air temperature measured by the station's thermometer, averaged to local-day means and then to monthly means with the same algorithm as the core station_temp series (docs/data/sources/ghcnh_taiwan.md).
variables.note_zh: 驗證層，不是 NASA 資料。與核心快照的 station_temp 是同一個量、同一個算法（逐時氣溫 → 當地日（UTC+8）平均 → 月平均，當月有觀測的天數不到 20 天不給月平均）；測站是台灣所有在 GHCNh 逐年檔（2000 年起）裡 2001–2025 至少有 240 個可用月份的測站。原始觀測來自中央氣象署與機場氣象單位，經 WMO／ICAO 交換；本 repo 只收錄月平均（衍生資料），供教育、非商業用途，不代表 NOAA 背書。
